## Why this operations change is needed

The next Core batch constructs actual finite-memory path laws and physical safety, relates actual finite-window conditioning to the same-source Doob path, and implements exact registered-carrier C3 search. Its production integration needs to refresh the existing live source DAG and append one compiler-certified reuse overlay.

## Exact scope

This PR changes only three strings in `COMPRESSION_RESEARCH_TRACKS.json`: the temporary exception ID, its exact branch pattern, and its reason. It retires the completed finite-memory exception and authorizes `compression/theory-completion-path-realization` for exactly the same six existing evidence, consumer, regression and navigation paths. The list of permitted paths is unchanged. All other policy values and bytes, Lean sources, old overlays and frozen classifications remain unchanged.

The new exception is `TC-PATH-REALIZATION-EVIDENCE-2026-10-22`. The scientific branch will consume the accepted resulting main as its immutable authorization baseline; this operations PR does not assert that the scientific integration has passed.

## Actual validation

- Starting main: `50a91fb9c81e0f5e698ce2cc02ec1a44c9583b04`.
- Independently reviewed candidate: `91366e9cf38815788978aeaf010f3016942d31dd`; tree `08e1f9869bdad2c8b1d2a95a602711ffaa1eb92b`.
- Both immutable-tree and committed-head governance runs passed with the unchanged baseline validator and the actual operations branch name.
- Independent root review confirmed exactly the three changed JSON strings and unchanged six-path scope; the new scientific branch has zero authorization on the old baseline and six paths only on the candidate policy.
- Exact-head Mac push passed; other remote refs stayed unchanged. A prior cloud push could not authenticate and made no remote change; its raw failure is retained.

No Lean build is claimed or needed for this policy-only diff. Scientific focused Lean, full build, native dependency/type/axiom checks, and canonical audit remain separate gates. The 106 P-ID dispositions, four counted generators, and `NOT_ESTABLISHED` global closure status are unchanged. Refs #146, #302; follows accepted #365.
